visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a group of approximately six people in a retro-styled outdoor plaza dancing with high energy. The central figures are a man in a denim jacket and a red-and-white checkered cloth tucked into his waistband, and a woman in a blue denim dress. They are smiling and gesturing towards the camera. The background features traditional low-rise buildings contrasted with modern skyscrapers under a bright, clear sky. (2) A close-up reaction shot appears of a person with short black hair and large round glasses, looking intently at the screen with a focused expression. The background is a dimly lit indoor room with posters on the wall. (3) The video cuts back to the MV scene, zooming in on the lower bodies of the two main male dancers. Their hands are clasped together in an unusual, slightly awkward manner while they continue to smile and dance. (4) A wide shot reveals the behind-the-scenes filming process, showing a tattooed cameraman with a gimbal stabilizer moving around the dancers. The footage then zooms in further on the specific 'strange' hand-holding moment in slow motion to emphasize the awkward grip.
